question: On the already frozen 16 generated 5x5 roots, is the symmetric-D3 static_v2-versus-Unit finite utility contrast attributable to leaf material values, capture-ordering values, or their interaction?
changed_premise: The preceding same-root panel varied one complete checkpoint in both leaves and ordering. Native SemanticSearchEngine has an existing separate ordering_checkpoint, enabling a matched 2x2 mechanism test without another rule sample. This reuses exact roots only for mechanism attribution; its outcomes are not an independent population panel and will not be pooled with the preceding panel.

rules.selection: Reuse only exact rule and opening roots from static_5x5_equal_d3_20261020. Analyzer must regenerate and compare every root file/hash before replay. No new seeds or roots.

arms.color_swap: Both candidate owners on each of 16 exact shared roots against an unchanged Unit-leaf/Unit-order foe.

contrasts.unknowns: For every contrast, each UNKNOWN game reward is independently bounded [-1,+1] before applying signed contrast coefficients; retain all-slot bounds and finite-only descriptive means.

decision: For each signed contrast, use the coefficient map and independent [-1,+1] bounds for every UNKNOWN reward. If only leaf contrasts have strictly positive all-slot bounds, finite utility difference is leaf-mediated in this sample; if only ordering contrasts do, it is order-mediated; if both or interaction matter, do not attribute the preceding gain to one component. If intervals overlap zero or are adversarial/seed-sensitive, leave mechanism unresolved. This does not choose a global price/default.

cost.expected: Below 4 minutes: 128 games on the exact roots completed in 72.454 seconds at the same symmetric D3 budgets in the preceding single-process panel. This run has the same slot count and fixed foe; its four candidate arms replace the previous two-candidate/two-foe combination.
cost.cheaper_alternative: A fixed-root action-only factorial is cheaper but cannot determine whether the mechanism carries game outcomes; the existing profiles and prior panel do not separate leaf from ordering checkpoints.

integrity: No training, solver, auxiliary checkout, new rules, roots or populations; no outcome pooling with the preceding panel.
Use the existing explicit ordering_checkpoint API; same Core, histories, D3/node/time/q/TT/root-window settings and unchanged Unit/Unit foe in every arm.
Preserve all outcomes, full histories, promotions, drops, actual terminals, UNKNOWNs and game/query costs.
